rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: few - the palm parkway; one tree per car-park island end (zone 106 -> about 80)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The car care corner's twenty-one builder trees go (a palm every 10 m along the north front, a row of five along the east front, corals, a jacaranda and torrey pines round the car park); seven come back on their own spots: five parkway palms about 30 m apart, kept clear of the pylon signs, and the two ends of the shared car park's island.

trees.why: the strip's north parkway in front of the chicken drive-in: the palm parkway, its west palm
the north parkway 38 m on, past the pylon sign (kept 19 m clear of it so the sign reads), opposite the diner
the north parkway 29 m on, toward the corner
the east parkway at the corner by the car wash, 7 m from its pylon sign: the parkway turns the corner
the east parkway 64 m on, in front of the tyre shop's yard fence: the next palm of the row
the south end of the shared car park's island (car care row, taqueria), by the lot light: the island-end tree
the north end of the same island, among the bird of paradise: the other island-end tree
